entries.subject: Imagery or colour of TRAPPIST-1f
entries.finding: No image, resolved colour or surface map of this planet exists or is expected: at 12.47 pc the planet's disc is microarcseconds across, and it is detected only in the light of its star. JWST has measured the mid-infrared dayside brightness of TRAPPIST-1b and c (Ducrot et al. 2024; Zieba et al. 2023) and phase curves of both (Gillon, Ducrot et al. 2025), which are thermal measurements rather than a colour; the raw observations are public in MAST and this project's JWST pipeline can reduce them.
